The '''Largo family''' was a powerful criminal family that was based in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Calamar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The family was a rival of the [[Ferlani family]], another Esseles-based criminal syndicate, and infrequent clashes occurred between the two. At some point, the Largo family gained some new political allies and at around the same time, a group of young upstarts from among Essles' criminal families arranged for [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] raids to stike down a number of their families. The Largo family's chieftains subsequently denied any involvement in causing the raids.<ref name="CCW" />
